title: Joinville hydrometeorological dataset — station master series and WRF forecast grid archive
description: Long-term, quality-controlled hydrometeorological record for Joinville (Santa Catarina, Brazil): the consolidated station master series (5-minute, hourly and daily) from the SEPROT / Defesa Civil de Joinville network, and a year-chunked archive of the CPTEC/INPE WRF (AMS, 7 km) forecast over the Joinville window (per grid cell, hourly: rainfall, 2 m temperature and 10 m wind). These files feed the live dashboard at https://jessicajcss.github.io/joinville_meteo/ . Times are Joinville local (UTC-3); model run cycles are labelled in UTC. Schema, units and quality-control rules are documented in DATA_ARCHIVE.md and on the dashboard's 'Sobre' page.
